verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a full public REST API (datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys) and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec for programmatic/agentic access, plus an official MCP server for agent-driven querying. Missing for 10: a live, directly-fetchable OpenAPI endpoint (probe found only 404s at standard paths) and independent/hands-on corroboration of API usage.
